name: Will professional drain cleaning damage my pipes?

mainEntity.name: Will professional drain cleaning damage my pipes?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, professional drain cleaning from experienced plumbers like CG Plumbing Solutions is designed to safely clear blockages without damaging your pipes. We use appropriate tools, such as professional-grade augers or hydro-jetting equipment, that are selected based on your pipe material and the nature of the clog. This approach protects your plumbing system while effectively resolving the issue.
acceptedAnswer.description: Professional drain cleaning uses specialized tools and techniques to safely clear clogs without damaging your pipes.
